headline: A 2014 law exempts certain condominium unit sales and leases from some federal land-sales registration and disclosure rules.
what_it_does: The Interstate Land Sales Full Disclosure Act normally requires sellers of certain land to register with the federal government and give buyers disclosure documents. This law changes that Act so that the sale or lease of a condominium unit is exempt from some of those registration and disclosure requirements, if the unit was not already exempt. The official summary does not give more detail on which units or which specific requirements are covered.

who_it_affects.how: Certain condominium unit sales and leases no longer need to meet some federal registration and disclosure requirements under the Interstate Land Sales Full Disclosure Act.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy or lease condominium units
who_it_affects.how: Some condominium transactions may no longer include the federal registration and disclosure documents that the Act would otherwise require.
